description: This PHP class 'LDAPUserCollection' encapsulates a collection of LDAP users, including their duplication status, failed users, and related metadata. It provides methods to access these properties and count duplicates.

classes.name: LDAPUserCollection
classes.description: A PHP class modeling a collection of LDAP users with duplicate and failed user tracking.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Returns the array of LDAPUser objects indexed by username.

methods.name: getDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns an array of usernames that are not unique in LDAP.

methods.name: getUsersOfDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns an array mapping usernames to arrays of LDAPUser objects, representing duplicate users.

methods.name: getDuplicateUserCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of duplicate LDAP users.

methods.name: getFailedUsers
methods.description: Returns an array of distinguished names (DNs) of users that failed processing.
